findings.text: _grant_round_scope catches every CrewError from widen_claim and reports it as a peer-held conflict, so a ClaimAmendmentRefusedError (the reviewed run's own worker still alive) or a claim-less pointer reaches the worker as 'held by peer run <its own id or unrecorded>' and the path is silently dropped from the round's scope; only ScopeConflict is a peer conflict and the rest should be re-raised or reported as their own refusal.
